module: Editor debug tool (menu Debug > Raycast Test) to compare two types of raycasts. Mode 0 "Gameengine Raycast": a translation gizmo places a point, a vertical Engine.castRay (±4 m) draws the impact point and the normal. Mode 1 "Physics Raycast": a grid of castRayStatic rays is fired around the cursor and the impacts are colored according to the distance to the camera. The mode is stored in the raycastTest.general.rayCastMode preference.
notes: onWindowMenuItem, editModeActivate/Update/Deactivate are local: they are wired via editor.editModes.checkTerrainCastRay and the menu, not exported.
The "Physics Raycast" mode divides by (maxDist - minDist): gives NaN if all impacts are at the same distance.

onEditorGui.desc: Hook: draws the "Raycast Test" window with a combo to choose the ray mode.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook: declares the checkTerrainCastRay edit mode (action map "RayCastTest"), registers the window and the Debug menu entry.

onEditorRegisterPreferences.desc: Hook: registers the raycastTest/general preferences category with rayCastMode (number, default 0, hidden).

onEditorToolWindowHide.desc: Hook: if the hidden window is "raycastTest", switches back to objectSelect edit mode.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads; empty.
